item.title: Caribbean islands were once the center of diversity for barn owls
item.description: Legend has it that a giant elfin, owl-like creature called the chickcharney haunts the islands of the Bahamas. item.title: ¿Por qué el pacto de La Meca no ha detenido los ataques hutíes en Arabia Saudita?
item.description: Pakistán, Turquía y Arabia Saudita firmaron en agosto de 2026 el llamado Pacto de La Meca, un acuerdo de defensa que establece que un ataque contra uno de los tres países será considerado un ataque contra todos. Sin embargo, cuando los hutíes intensificaron sus ataques contra territorio saudí, surgieron preguntas sobre la aparente falta de una respuesta conjunta. ¿Qué pasa con el acuerdo? Farid Kahhat, internacionalista y académico de la Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú, aborda el tema en France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: 'Terror of kings': Why the 1066 appearance of Halley's Comet terrified the medieval world
item.description: A sequence on the Bayeux Tapestry shows King Harold alongside a crowd gazing at the sky, beneath the embroidered caption Isti mirant stella ("those people marvel at the star"). Above Harold sits Halley's Comet, with ghostlike invasion boats in the border below—a Norman framing of Harold as a doomed usurper whose betrayal invited destruction. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: New study reveals the high financial value of privacy in legal proceedings

item.title: Egypt involvement in Yemen 'may actually weaken Cairo's regional role', expert says
item.description: Egypt's parliament on Monday delayed a debate on President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi's request to authorise military support for Saudi Arabia until next week, state media reported, after an emergency session ended without a decision a day earlier. FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney speaks with Dr May Darwich, Associate Professor in International Relations of the Middle East at the University of Birmingham. She explains that "this kind of military operation does not really have any objectives or exit strategy so at the moment this might actually weaken Egypt's regional role". Fuente: France 24 - English.
